verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents only email inboxes: API, IMAP/SMTP, webhooks and websockets. Nothing in the evidence shows the same inbox also handling SMS, WhatsApp, social or live chat. The OpenClaw integration places email 'alongside your existing chat channels', but those channels belong to the host platform, not AgentMail. The LiveKit guide adds email to a voice agent rather than other channels to the inbox, and a community user asking about phone numbers suggests the capability is absent.

support.subject: As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email
